description: This module manages the creation/removal of a user account on PagerDuty.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: An API access token to authenticate with the PagerDuty REST API.

parameters.name: pd_email
parameters.description: The user’s email address. pd_email is the unique identifier used and cannot be updated using this module.

parameters.name: pd_teams
parameters.description: The teams to which the user belongs. Required if state=present.

parameters.name: pd_user
parameters.description: Name of the user in PagerDuty.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the user. On present, it creates a user if the user does not exist. On absent, it removes a user if the account exists. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

examples:
- name: Create a user account on PagerDuty
  community.general.pagerduty_user:
    access_token: 'Your_Access_token'
    pd_user: user_full_name
    pd_email: user_email
    pd_role: user_pd_role
    pd_teams: user_pd_teams
    state: "present"

- name: Remove a user account from PagerDuty
  community.general.pagerduty_user:
    access_token: 'Your_Access_token'
    pd_user: user_full_name
    pd_email: user_email
    state: "absent"
